item.title: Write the Cleanup Headline

turns.text: Make a square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly illustrated seaside scene, with a short catchy headline — you pick the words. No dates or signup details.

item.tests: Checks that the agent writes and renders a suitable headline rather than asking the user for wording or omitting text.

answer_sheet.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

must_haves: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
No dates or signup details appear.

Here’s ready-to-use copy for a beach-cleanup poster:

🌊 **LOVE YOUR BEACH**  
**HELP KEEP IT CLEAN**

Join a local beach cleanup.

**Bring gloves. Pick up litter. Make a difference.**

*Design idea: ocean-blue and sunny-yellow colors, with an illustration of volunteers collecting litter along the shore.*

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished, cheerful community-action poster encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Square graphic, beautiful flat vector illustration with subtle paper texture, ocean teal, sunny yellow, coral and cream palette. Show diverse adult volunteers wearing protective gloves collecting plastic bottles and litter into reusable collection bags on a beautiful sandy beach, with blue waves and a rising sun behind them. Strong clear composition, high contrast and excellent typography. Include only these exact words, spelled correctly and arranged in a clear hierarchy: large bold headline at top 'LOVE YOUR BEACH'; prominent secondary headline 'HELP KEEP IT CLEAN'; short supporting line 'Join a local beach cleanup'; small footer 'Bring gloves. Pick up litter. Make a difference.' Make the headline and call to action very legible at phone-screen size. Friendly, optimistic, inspiring environmental campaign design, professional editorial illustration, ample breathing room around text. No logos, no invented event date, no website.
